---
name: requirements-analysis
description: "Analyze a software change request, identify scope and ambiguities, and write testable acceptance criteria. Use before planning or implementation."
---
# Requirements Analysis

1. Restate the user problem and intended outcome without adding features.
2. Inspect only relevant project documentation and implementation to establish current behavior.
3. Separate functional requirements, quality constraints, in-scope work, and explicit exclusions.
4. Write observable, verifiable acceptance criteria; include failure and boundary cases that matter.
5. Mark assumptions, risks, dependencies, and unresolved decisions. Escalate blocking ambiguity to the orchestrator for a user question.
6. Return the structured handoff defined in `.github/agents/requirements-analyst.agent.md`. Do not edit files.
